#1 La noticia en el NewZimbabwe.com:

Uganda passes bill banning identifying as gay and lesbian
https://www.newzimbabwe.com/uganda-passes-bill-banning-identifying-as-gay-and-lesbian/%3famp=1 - The law also bans promoting and abetting homosexuality as well as conspiracy to engage in homosexuality.

[...]
More than 30 African countries, including Uganda, already ban same-sex relations. The new law appears to be the first to outlaw merely identifying as lesbian, gay, bisexual, transgender, intersex, queer/questioning, asexual and more (LGBTIQA+), according to rights group Human Rights Watch.

[...]
Violations under the law draw steep penalties including death for so called aggravated homosexuality and life in prison for gay sex. Aggravated homosexuality involves gay sex with people under 18 years old or when the perpetrator is HIV positive, among other categories, according to the law.

“Our creator God is happy (about) what is happening… I support the bill to protect the future of our children,” said lawmaker David Bahati during debate on the bill.
